images.technical_visual_review: Compared with actual canonical Christ reference: recognizable facial structure, brown wavy hair and beard retained; solemn, attentive expression toward struggling pioneer, no smile. Natural pushing pose, visible healed wrist marks, covered palms. Helpers in plain pale clothing without wings or halos. Owner-selected river composition preserved. Historical October 19 crossing distinguished from devotional heavenly presence.
